$comment: Eighth family. Scope and duration are deliberately SEPARATE requirements: an NDA can
have excellent scope and defective duration, or the reverse, and neither may compensate
for the other in the coverage report.
The requirements below describe what is OBSERVABLE. None of them says 'without a
public-domain carve-out the obligation is unenforceable' -- that is a legal conclusion,
and this layer is not permitted to reach one. What it can establish is whether the
instrument identifies the circumstances in which information ceases to qualify for
protection. Whether the resulting drafting is legally sufficient is for an advocate.

requirements.statement: What counts as Confidential Information is defined.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and the obligation has no subject: there is nothing identifiable that the receiving party is bound to protect.

requirements.statement: The circumstances in which information ceases to qualify for protection are identified.
requirements.identity_test: Remove them and the instrument does not distinguish information it protects from information that stays burdened merely because it was once disclosed — a distinction the parties cannot make later without the instrument's help.

requirements.statement: Disclosure compelled by law or by an authority is addressed.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and a recipient served with an order must choose between breaching the agreement and disobeying the order, with no stated route through.

requirements.statement: What the recipient must do with the information is stated.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and the instrument names a subject and imposes nothing.

requirements.statement: Disclosure to the recipient's own people and advisers is controlled.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and the obligation binds a company whose employees are bound by nothing.

requirements.statement: Return or destruction of the information on demand or on ending is dealt with.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and the disclosing party has no route to recover what it disclosed once the discussion fails.

requirements.statement: The obligation that continues after return or destruction is distinguished from the physical act.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and returning the documents is read as discharging the duty, when copies in backups, in email and in memory are exactly what the duty was for.

requirements.statement: How long the obligation runs is stated.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and neither party can say when the burden ends, and a perpetual obligation is read into an instrument nobody intended to be perpetual.

falsification.attack: Took the NDA the product generates today — every expected clause id present, each clause well drafted on its own — and asked not whether the requirements were satisfied but whether the satisfied clauses agreed with one another about the period they all govern.
falsification.false_green: 9 of 9 reported RESOLVED for an instrument whose NDA_DURATION_001 says confidentiality survives five years and whose NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001 says three, and the declared relationship between them was silently discarded because the model had no notion of relationships. The clause library forces the pairing: NDA_DURATION_001 lists NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001 in required_with.

requirements.statement: What follows a breach is stated.
requirements.identity_test: Remove it and damages are the only route, for a loss that is characteristically hard to quantify.

$relationships_comment: Requirements that are each satisfied and jointly incoherent.
The five-family corpus established that PRESENCE is not SATISFACTION. This establishes
the next thing: SATISFACTION of each requirement is not COHERENCE between them. Every
NDA this system ships contains NDA_DURATION_001, which says the obligation continues for
five years after termination, and NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001, which says it survives for a
further three years. Both clauses are individually well drafted. Every requirement above
is satisfied. The document states two different answers to the only question a
The check is deterministic and evidence-based: a declared extraction from each clause's
own text, compared. It is not a judgment that two clauses 'seem inconsistent'.

relationships.must_agree_on: the period for which confidentiality obligations run after the agreement ends
$comment: Anchored on survival language rather than on any 'period of N years' phrasing, because
NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001 states TWO periods: the term of the agreement itself (two years) and
the post-termination confidentiality period (three years). An unanchored extract would read
the term out of one clause and the survival period out of the other and compare two different
things -- and comparing the wrong quantities is a worse failure than not comparing at all,
because it produces a confident finding.
What this relationship does NOT decide: whether either period is reasonable under section 27
of the Contract Act, or which of the two ought to govern. Both are legal conclusions. It
establishes only that the instrument states two and does not say which.
relationships.identity_test: Remove it and the instrument states two different post-termination confidentiality periods, each in a clause that reads correctly on its own, and the requirement model reports both clauses present and every requirement satisfied.
